{{Quote|Looks like there is still fight left in these Republic troops. Land our droids, I want this ship!|General Grievous|<ref name="Adventures">{{TCWA|Republic Defender}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guardian'']] was '''assaulted''' by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who had previously damaged the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in [[Battle at Tallis Outpost|battle]] at [[Tallis Outpost]].
